quote.speaker: Walpurgis
quote.text: "So the Kingdom still has an army?"

quote.speaker: Unknown
quote.text: "Not an army. A village that refuses to stop fighting. It's not the same thing, but Eggman keeps losing to it anyway."

The resistance movement of the Acorn Kingdom. Born during Eggman's first occupation and never disbanded, the Freedom Fighters operate out of Knothole Village, protecting the scattered settlements of the southeast and raiding deep into the territory held by the Northern Eggman Army.

groups.title: Leaders
groups.description: The ones who decide where the next raid goes.

characters.name: Sally Acorn
characters.description: Princess of the Acorn Kingdom and the one who holds the movement together.
